name: @pipeworx/mcp-gitlab-public

tools.name: search_projects
tools.description: Search public GitLab projects by keyword, sorted by popularity. Returns project ID, name, description, star count, fork count, open issues, and web URL.

limit.description: Number of results to return (default 10, max 100)

tools.name: get_project
tools.description: Get full details for a public GitLab project by numeric ID or "namespace/project" path (e.g., "gitlab-org/gitlab"). Pass the path as written, with a plain slash — do not URL-encode it, the tool handles that internally. Returns name, description, stars, forks, default branch, topics, and last activity date.

id.description: Project numeric ID (e.g., "278964") or "namespace/project" path with a plain slash (e.g., "gitlab-org/gitlab"). Do not percent-encode the slash.

tools.name: search_issues
tools.description: Search issues across public GitLab projects by keyword. Returns issue title, state, author, labels, project ID, and direct URL.

query.description: Search query for issue titles and descriptions

limit.description: Number of results to return (default 10, max 100)

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-gitlab-public forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the gitlab-public pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
